description: Public reusable Midjourney prompt templates normalized from official documentation. These are original/normalized formulations, not private system prompts.

prompts.title: Focused Subject Scene
prompts.prompt: Create a [MEDIUM] of [SUBJECT] in [ENVIRONMENT], with [LIGHTING], [COLOR_PALETTE], [MOOD], and [COMPOSITION]. Keep the description focused on the visual elements that matter most. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Photographic Portrait
prompts.prompt: Photorealistic portrait of [SUBJECT], [EXPRESSION], [OUTFIT], in [ENVIRONMENT], [LIGHTING], [CAMERA_COMPOSITION]. Emphasize realistic skin, natural proportions, and the key visual details. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Medium and Style
prompts.prompt: [SUBJECT] rendered as a [MEDIUM] in the style of [STYLE_DIRECTION], using [COLOR_PALETTE] and [LIGHTING], with [MOOD] and [COMPOSITION]. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Environment and Mood
prompts.prompt: [SUBJECT] in a [ENVIRONMENT], during [TIME_PERIOD], with [WEATHER], [LIGHTING], [COLOR_PALETTE], and a [MOOD] atmosphere. Compose the image as [COMPOSITION]. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Controlled Color Palette
prompts.prompt: [SUBJECT], [MEDIUM], with a [COLOR_PALETTE] palette, [LIGHTING], [MOOD], and [COMPOSITION]. Keep the requested colors visually prominent without adding unrelated color themes. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Historical Era Visual
prompts.prompt: Illustration of [SUBJECT] set in the [TIME_PERIOD] era, using period-appropriate [CLOTHING_OR_OBJECTS], [ARCHITECTURE_OR_ENVIRONMENT], [MEDIUM], [LIGHTING], and [COLOR_PALETTE]. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Reference-Guided Creation
prompts.prompt: Use the supplied image as a visual reference for [CONTENT_OR_COMPOSITION]. Create [SUBJECT] with [ADDITIONAL_DETAILS]. Treat the reference as inspiration for visual structure rather than an exact copy. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Multiple Image References
prompts.prompt: Combine the supplied image references to inspire [SUBJECT_OR_SCENE]. Use reference 1 for [ROLE_1], reference 2 for [ROLE_2], and reference 3 for [ROLE_3]. Add [TEXTUAL_DETAILS] to define what is not clear in the references. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Style Reference
prompts.prompt: Create [SUBJECT_OR_SCENE] using the supplied style reference to guide the overall visual language, while preserving the requested subject and composition. Match the reference's [STYLE_ATTRIBUTES] without copying unrelated content. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Targeted Image Edit
prompts.prompt: Edit the supplied image by changing only [TARGET_AREA] to [NEW_CONTENT]. Preserve the rest of the image, including [PRESERVE_DETAILS], and keep perspective, lighting, texture, and scale coherent. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Canvas Extension
prompts.prompt: Extend the supplied image toward [DIRECTION_OR_ASPECT_RATIO]. Keep the original content intact and generate only the missing environment, continuing perspective, lighting, textures, and composition naturally. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Consistent Subject Reference
prompts.prompt: Create [SCENE] featuring the same [PERSON_OR_OBJECT] from the supplied reference. Preserve recognizable identity and key visual traits while changing [SCENE_CHANGES]. Keep the result coherent with the requested setting. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Readable Text in Image
prompts.prompt: Create [IMAGE_TYPE] featuring the exact words "[TEXT]" as [TEXT_ELEMENT]. Use [TYPOGRAPHY_STYLE], clear hierarchy, and strong legibility. Keep the text short and prominently placed. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Describe Image for Prompt Ideas
prompts.prompt: Analyze the supplied image and generate several distinct creative prompt directions describing its important subject, medium, environment, lighting, color, mood, and composition. Do not attempt to reproduce the image verbatim.

prompts.title: Precise Composition
prompts.prompt: [SUBJECT] in [ENVIRONMENT], composed as a [COMPOSITION], viewed from [CAMERA_VIEW], with [LIGHTING] and [MOOD]. Keep [KEY_ELEMENT] as the visual focal point and use [NEGATIVE_SPACE] as intentional breathing room. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Exact Count of Subjects
prompts.prompt: A scene containing exactly [NUMBER] [SUBJECTS], arranged as [ARRANGEMENT], in [ENVIRONMENT], with [LIGHTING] and [MOOD]. Keep the count explicit and visually distinguishable. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Concise Creative Prompt
prompts.prompt: [SUBJECT], [MEDIUM], [ENVIRONMENT], [LIGHTING], [MOOD]. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Aspect Ratio Controlled Scene
prompts.prompt: [SUBJECT] in [ENVIRONMENT], [MEDIUM], [LIGHTING], [COMPOSITION]. Optimize the composition for the requested output ratio. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Version-Specific Prompt
prompts.prompt: Create [SUBJECT_OR_SCENE] with [STYLE_AND_DETAILS]. Use Midjourney version [VERSION] and apply only the parameters needed for the intended result. [PARAMETERS]

prompts.title: Reference Plus Text Direction
prompts.prompt: Use the supplied image as a reference for [REFERENCE_ROLE]. Create the final image as [FINAL_SCENE], with [TEXT_DIRECTION] controlling details not established by the reference. Preserve the important requested visual structure while allowing the text prompt to define the new result. [PARAMETERS]
